scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose/compose.yaml up -d postgres redis nats step-ca opa
scripts.infra:migrate: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --profile tools run --rm migrate
scripts.pki:init: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --profile tools run --rm step-ca-init
scripts.policy:test: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --profile tools run --rm opa-test
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:messaging
